meaning.en: Living simply and frugally, able to endure hardship.
meaning.zh: 能吃苦耐劳，生活俭朴。

examples.zh: 老一辈人艰苦朴素的作风值得我们学习。
examples.en: We should learn from our elders' frugal, hard-working ways.

examples.zh: 他当了老板，生活依然艰苦朴素。
examples.en: Even as a boss he still lives very simply.

examples.zh: 学校提倡艰苦朴素，反对攀比。
examples.en: The school encourages plain living and discourages showing off.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; often 艰苦朴素的作风.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，常说“艰苦朴素的作风”。

meaning.en: Faint and indistinct; barely seen, heard or felt.
meaning.zh: 模糊不清，不明显。

examples.zh: 远处隐隐约约传来歌声。
examples.en: Singing drifted faintly from the distance.

examples.zh: 雾里隐隐约约能看见几座山。
examples.en: A few hills were dimly visible through the mist.

examples.zh: 我隐隐约约觉得事情不对劲。
examples.en: I had a vague feeling something was wrong.

natural: be among the first to see

meaning.en: To delight in being among the first to see or read something.
meaning.zh: 以能尽先看到为快乐。

equivalents: be among the first to see

examples.zh: 新书一出版，读者们就争相先睹为快。
examples.en: As soon as the book came out, readers rushed to get their hands on it.

examples.zh: 这部电影今晚首映，影迷们都想先睹为快。
examples.en: The film premieres tonight, and fans are dying to see it first.

examples.zh: 新手机发布会上，大家都想先睹为快。
examples.en: At the phone launch, everyone wanted an early look.

story.en: Han Yu wrote that officials at court 'craned their necks to the east, vying to be the first to see' the hermit Li Bo, as if he were an auspicious star.
story.zh: 韩愈《与少室李拾遗书》：“朝廷之士，引颈东望，若景星凤凰之始见也，争先睹之为快。”

usage.en: Predicate; often 争相/一睹……先睹为快.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“争相先睹为快”。

meaning.en: The way one speaks and behaves.
meaning.zh: 说话的内容、态度和行为举动。

equivalents: the way one talks and acts

examples.zh: 从他的言谈举止可以看出，他受过良好的教育。
examples.en: You can tell from the way he talks and behaves that he's well educated.

examples.zh: 面试时要注意言谈举止。
examples.en: Watch your manner and bearing in an interview.

examples.zh: 她言谈举止大方得体。
examples.en: Her demeanour is poised and gracious.

meaning.en: To spring into action as soon as one hears the news.
meaning.zh: 一听到消息就立即行动。

examples.zh: 接到报警后，警察闻风而动。
examples.en: The police sprang into action as soon as the call came in.

examples.zh: 政策一出台，各地闻风而动。
examples.en: As soon as the policy was announced, every region moved to implement it.

examples.zh: 听说商场打折，大妈们闻风而动。
examples.en: Word of the sale got out and the shoppers descended at once.

meaning.en: So poor that one's home has nothing but four bare walls.
meaning.zh: 家里只有四面墙壁，形容极其贫困。

equivalents: not a penny to one's name
as poor as a church mouse

examples.zh: 他小时候家徒四壁，靠奖学金读完了大学。
examples.en: He grew up dirt-poor and got through university on scholarships.

examples.zh: 那场大火之后，他们家徒四壁。
examples.en: After the fire they were left with nothing but bare walls.

examples.zh: 虽然家徒四壁，父母还是坚持让孩子上学。
examples.en: Although they had nothing, the parents insisted on sending their children to school.

story.en: When Zhuo Wenjun eloped with the poet Sima Xiangru, his home in Chengdu had 'nothing but four walls standing' (家居徒四壁立).
story.zh: 《史记·司马相如列传》：“文君夜亡奔相如，相如乃与驰归成都，家居徒四壁立。”

meaning.en: A forest of guns and a rain of bullets: fierce fighting.
meaning.zh: 枪支如林，子弹如雨，形容战斗激烈。

examples.zh: 战地记者冒着枪林弹雨采访。
examples.en: The war correspondent reported under heavy fire.

examples.zh: 爷爷在枪林弹雨中救出了战友。
examples.en: Grandpa rescued his comrade in a hail of bullets.

examples.zh: 他们是从枪林弹雨中走过来的老兵。
examples.en: They are veterans who have been through the thick of battle.

usage.en: Object; often 冒着枪林弹雨.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“冒着枪林弹雨”。

natural: see which way the wind is blowing

meaning.en: Seeing that things are going badly (and acting accordingly, usually by escaping).
meaning.zh: 看到形势不好。

equivalents: see which way the wind is blowing

examples.zh: 小偷见势不妙，转身就跑。
examples.en: Sensing trouble, the thief turned and ran.

examples.zh: 他见势不妙，赶紧把股票卖了。
examples.en: Seeing things go south, he quickly sold his shares.

examples.zh: 敌军见势不妙，纷纷撤退。
examples.en: Seeing the battle turning against them, the enemy troops pulled back.

usage.en: Predicate; usually followed by the reaction.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后面常接采取的行动。

meaning.en: To punish someone as a warning to others not to follow their example.
meaning.zh: 用对一个坏人或一件坏事的严肃处理来警告其他人不要学着做坏事。

examples.zh: 学校开除了作弊的学生，以儆效尤。
examples.en: The school expelled the cheats as a warning to others.

examples.zh: 对这种违规行为必须严惩，以儆效尤。
examples.en: Violations like this must be punished severely, to deter others.

examples.zh: 球队重罚了迟到的球员，以儆效尤。
examples.en: The club fined the late player heavily to make an example of him.

usage.en: Predicate; usually the second half of a sentence.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常放在句子后半部分。

natural: neither one thing nor the other

meaning.en: Neither one thing nor the other; incongruous.
meaning.zh: 既不像这一类，也不像那一类，形容不像样或不规范。

equivalents: neither one thing nor the other

examples.zh: 这座建筑中西混搭，显得不伦不类。
examples.en: The building mixes Chinese and Western styles and ends up looking incongruous.

examples.zh: 他穿西装配拖鞋，不伦不类。
examples.en: A suit with flip-flops just looks wrong.

examples.zh: 把古诗改成网络语言，有点不伦不类。
examples.en: Rewriting classical poems in internet slang is a bit of a mismatch.

meaning.en: Ruined and disgraced.
meaning.zh: 地位丧失，名誉扫地。

examples.zh: 他因受贿而身败名裂。
examples.en: He was disgraced for taking bribes.

examples.zh: 一次丑闻就让这位明星身败名裂。
examples.en: A single scandal ruined the star.

examples.zh: 贪图小利，最后落得身败名裂。
examples.en: His petty greed ended in total disgrace.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; often 落得身败名裂.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常说“落得身败名裂”。

meaning.en: Glittering waves on water.
meaning.zh: 水面在阳光或月光下闪闪发光。

examples.zh: 夕阳下，湖面波光粼粼。
examples.en: In the setting sun the lake shimmered.

examples.zh: 月光洒在波光粼粼的海面上。
examples.en: Moonlight fell on the glittering sea.

examples.zh: 小河波光粼粼，孩子们在岸边玩耍。
examples.en: The stream sparkled as children played on the bank.

natural: as if no one else were there

meaning.en: Behaving as if nobody else were around; self-absorbed or arrogant.
meaning.zh: 好像旁边没有人，形容态度自然或高傲。

equivalents: as if no one else were there

examples.zh: 他在地铁上旁若无人地大声打电话。
examples.en: He talked loudly on the phone on the Tube as if no one else were there.

examples.zh: 那对情侣在餐厅里旁若无人地吵起来。
examples.en: The couple started rowing in the restaurant, oblivious to everyone.

examples.zh: 她旁若无人地专心练琴。
examples.en: She practised the piano, completely absorbed.

story.en: Jing Ke and his friend Gao Jianli would drink in the Yan market, singing and weeping together 'as if there were no one around them' (旁若无人).
story.zh: 《史记·刺客列传》：“已而相泣，旁若无人者。”

meaning.en: To keep silent and say nothing.
meaning.zh: 不说话，不出声。

examples.zh: 大家都在讨论，只有他默不作声。
examples.en: Everyone was talking except him; he said nothing.

examples.zh: 被批评后，她默不作声地离开了。
examples.en: After being told off, she left without a word.

examples.zh: 面对不公，我们不能默不作声。
examples.en: We can't stay silent in the face of injustice.

meaning.en: Showing one's liver and gall to each other: complete sincerity and loyalty between friends.
meaning.zh: 比喻以真心相待。

examples.zh: 他们俩是肝胆相照的好朋友。
examples.en: The two of them are true, loyal friends.

examples.zh: 合作伙伴之间要肝胆相照。
examples.en: Partners should be completely open with each other.

examples.zh: 多年来，他们肝胆相照，共渡难关。
examples.en: For years they've stood by each other through thick and thin.

meaning.en: Think it over carefully before acting.
meaning.zh: 反复考虑后再去做。

examples.zh: 辞职是大事，你要三思而后行。
examples.en: Quitting is a big step; think it through first.

examples.zh: 投资有风险，三思而后行。
examples.en: Investing is risky, so look before you leap.

examples.zh: 说话之前最好三思而后行。
examples.en: It's best to think twice before you speak.

story.en: The Analects: 'Ji Wenzi thought three times before acting.' Confucius, hearing this, said 'Twice is enough' (季文子三思而后行).
story.zh: 《论语·公冶长》：“季文子三思而后行。子闻之，曰：‘再，斯可矣。’”

meaning.en: To take in and accommodate many different things or views.
meaning.zh: 把不同内容、不同性质的东西收罗起来，保存下来。

examples.zh: 这所大学学风自由，兼容并蓄。
examples.en: The university has a free and inclusive academic culture.

examples.zh: 中华文化兼容并蓄，吸收了很多外来元素。
examples.en: Chinese culture is all-embracing and has absorbed many foreign elements.

examples.zh: 他的音乐风格兼容并蓄。
examples.en: His musical style is eclectic.

meaning.en: So well guarded or argued that there is no weak point to attack.
meaning.zh: 没有可以被攻击的弱点，形容十分严密。

examples.zh: 他的论证无懈可击。
examples.en: His argument is watertight.

examples.zh: 这场比赛她的表现无懈可击。
examples.en: Her performance in the match was flawless.

examples.zh: 这份合同写得无懈可击。
examples.en: The contract is impeccably drafted.

meaning.en: An expert; a skilled practitioner.
meaning.zh: 精通某种业务的人。

examples.zh: 修车他可是行家里手。
examples.en: He's an old hand at fixing cars.

examples.zh: 她是做电商的行家里手。
examples.en: She's an e-commerce pro.

examples.zh: 请行家里手来看看，就知道真假了。
examples.en: Get an expert to look and you'll know if it's genuine.

meaning.en: To prolong one's life.
meaning.zh: 延长寿命，增加岁数。

examples.zh: 经常锻炼可以延年益寿。
examples.en: Regular exercise can add years to your life.

examples.zh: 这种茶据说有延年益寿的功效。
examples.en: This tea is said to promote longevity.

examples.zh: 祝您身体健康，延年益寿！
examples.en: Wishing you good health and a long life!

meaning.en: To injure sinews and bones; figuratively, to suffer serious damage at the core.
meaning.zh: 指筋骨受伤，也比喻受到严重损害。

examples.zh: 俗话说，伤筋动骨一百天。
examples.en: As the saying goes, broken bones take a hundred days to heal.

examples.zh: 这次改革不伤筋动骨，就难见成效。
examples.en: Reform won't work unless it goes to the core.

examples.zh: 这场危机让公司伤筋动骨。
examples.en: The crisis dealt the company a serious blow.

natural: as one falls, another takes his place

meaning.en: As those in front fall, those behind press on: heroic, unending sacrifice.
meaning.zh: 前面的倒下了，后面的紧跟上去，形容英勇奋斗，不怕牺牲。

equivalents: as one falls, another takes his place

examples.zh: 革命先烈前仆后继，换来了今天的和平。
examples.en: Wave after wave of martyrs gave their lives for today's peace.

examples.zh: 科学家们前仆后继，终于攻克了这种疾病。
examples.en: Generation after generation of scientists pressed on until the disease was beaten.

examples.zh: 为了自由，人们前仆后继地斗争。
examples.en: People fought for freedom, one stepping in as another fell.

meaning.en: To attack cities and seize land; figuratively, to aggressively capture markets.
meaning.zh: 攻打城池，夺取土地；也比喻在市场等方面大举扩张。

examples.zh: 这支军队一路攻城略地。
examples.en: The army conquered city after city.

examples.zh: 国产手机在海外市场攻城略地。
examples.en: Chinese phone makers are grabbing market share abroad.

examples.zh: 新品牌攻城略地，老牌企业压力很大。
examples.en: New brands are sweeping in and putting the old names under pressure.

meaning.en: To put up stubborn resistance from a cornered position.
meaning.zh: 依靠险要的地势顽固抵抗。

equivalents: fight with one's back to the wall

examples.zh: 残敌负隅顽抗，最终被全部歼灭。
examples.en: The remaining enemy made a last stand but were wiped out.

examples.zh: 嫌犯躲在屋里负隅顽抗，被警察制服。
examples.en: The suspect held out in the house but was overpowered by police.

examples.zh: 证据确凿，你就别再负隅顽抗了。
examples.en: The evidence is conclusive — stop fighting it.

story.en: Mencius describes a tiger 'with its back to a corner of the mountain' (虎负嵎), which no one dares approach — the image behind the idiom.
story.zh: 《孟子·尽心下》：“有众逐虎，虎负嵎，莫之敢撄。”
